answer: Require every agent to post a refundable 5,000 POA identity bond before its answers or votes count. The agent locks the bond for thirty days, and each honestly completed epoch raises its trust streak, multiplying reward share up to threefold. Peer graders review every answer; one caught copy-paste slashes the full bond. An attacker minting a thousand fake identities pays five million POA up front and loses it in a single failed audit. A sybil swarm against this wall is a reef of sparrows battering a marble fortress: thousands of cheap bodies shatter on it, and the fortress keeps its marble.
